description: Defines the 'base::File' class, a wrapper around OS-level file operations, including file handling, reading, writing, locking, and error management. Contains enums for flags and errors, and a nested Info struct for file metadata.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A wrapper around OS-level file operations, providing methods for opening, reading, writing, seeking, locking, and retrieving file info.

classes.name: File::Info
classes.description: Structure holding metadata about a file, such as size, timestamps, and type.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Creates or opens a file with specified path and flags.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file handle is valid.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Changes current position in the file.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file at a specific offset.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the file at a specific offset.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Truncates or extends the file to a specified length.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Attempts to lock the file exclusively.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases a lock on the file.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate handle to the file.

methods.name: GetLastFileError
methods.description: Returns the last global error as a 'base::File::Error'.

methods.name: ErrorToString
methods.description: Converts a 'base::File::Error' to a human-readable string.
